evidence.description: BNM API responds HTTP 200 even when row data is structurally inconsistent, including missing columns or null content_date. The probe treats HTTP 200 as success with anomaly_detected=True, so future rules must not accept 200 without validation.

impact_on_claim_or_decision: A future probe rule that trusts HTTP 200 without per-row content_date inspection would silently regress.
resolution_or_quarantine: Current probe emits anomaly_detected; HS-05 should assert 200 only with valid row data.
rule_or_policy_change: Current rule is correct; this is a future regression anchor.

regression_test.description: The format contract retains the deliberately empty affected_datasets array.
